source_prs.PR_159: Jules DISPATER baseline convergence (commit e69b22d / d6da58e)

implemented_capabilities: Durable SQLite persistence (dispater_runs, dispater_findings) with WAL mode, foreign keys, busy timeout, and persistent /data mount detection
Storage mount validation (validate_storage_mount) strictly executed before sqlite3 connection, rejecting /tmp if persistent storage required
Explicit WAL checkpointing (checkpoint) ensuring full disk durability
Fail-closed tenant authorization (AUREX_DISPATER_TENANT_GRANTS SHA-256 token digest mapping)
Full multi-tenant isolation with uniform 403 responses across existing and non-existing unauthorized tenants
Asynchronous streaming body size enforcement in limit_body dependency with 5MB ceiling caching into request._body without handler starvation
Independent financial reference oracle computing expected underbilling, overbilling, and unverified exposure
Non-delegable authority invariants blocking prompt injection and self-release attempts
Strict exposure classification (potential underbilling, potential overbilling, unverified exposure, confirmed recovery = 0.00)
Audit run history, detail lookup by run ID, and JSON/CSV report export
Server-only website proxy with strict production URL validation and zero secret leakage
Interactive website reconciliation console on route /dispater with report export
remaining_blockers: 1. Production merge into main requires explicit human Product Owner authorization.
2. Staging deployment requires Railway volume /data mount confirmation for persistent SQLite storage.
3. Commercial live pilot requires signed customer agreement and field connector credentials.
recommended_next_engineering_operation: Product Owner review and merge of PR #159, PR #160, and integration candidate, followed by controlled staging deployment smoke check.
